messages.content: 紐約現在的人口是多少？

function.name: time_converter
function.description: Converts the local time of user's region to the target region's local time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_timezone.description: The timezone of the user in string format. Example: 'Pacific Time (US & Canada)'

target_timezone.description: The target timezone in string format where user wants to know the local time. Example: 'Eastern Time (US & Canada)'

time.description: The local time of user's timezone in string format (24 hr format). Optional parameter. Example: '15:30:00'

message.content: 截至 2023 年底，紐約市（New York City）的估計人口約為 **860 萬**。如果你想知道更精確的數字或是州層面的統計，我可以再幫你查詢最新資料。
message.reasoning: User asks: "紐約現在的人口是多少？" which means "What is the current population of New York?" They want the current population of New York. We need to provide an answer. There's no mention of time conversion. So we just give the population. According to latest estimates, New York City has about 8.5 million people. But maybe they want the population of the state? Usually "紐約" refers to New York City. Provide approximate number. Use up-to-date estimate: 8.6 million as of 2023. Provide source. No tool needed.
